channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Mesh Repair Without Hysterectomy Shows Better Long-Term Results for Prolapse
item.description: A study found that vaginal mesh hysteropexy had fewer treatment failures than hysterectomy with suspension over a decade of follow-up.

item.title: Low In-Hospital Mortality for Elective Atrial Fibrillation Ablation
item.description: In-hospital death rate for elective catheter ablation of atrial fibrillation was very low, around 0.029%, according to recent data.

item.title: Daraxonrasib Shows Promise in Pretreated RAS-Mutant NSCLC
item.description: In patients with advanced RAS-mutant non-small-cell lung cancer, daraxonrasib led to objective responses in about one-third of cases.

item.title: Earlier Genetic Testing Linked to Higher Bilateral Mastectomy Rates in Young BRCA Carriers
item.description: Over 20 years, bilateral mastectomy use rose among BRCA carriers aged 40 or younger with early breast cancer, while breast-conserving surgery declined.
